name: bozzies/quotes-carousel
title: Quotes carousel
description: Astro's interactive quotes carousel — the .qc module with auto-rotating slides, prev/next arrows, and dot indicators. Verbatim from ~/boswell-poc/src/components/QuotesCarousel.astro. Quotes (text + attribution) are stored on the block; front-end JS wires up rotation, hover/focus pause, and arrow-key nav.
